summary: Round 45 plan check (18:13-18:20Z, 0 Kaggle calls). exp89t 56669888 still PENDING at the 18:15:19Z header (L_lo 9.25 h; the CI pool gives L 8.88-9.48 h, so the read should land at the 18:25 or 18:35Z header). Script hashes match CONTEXT 17:54Z (readtime.sh befef6fb, msg44.py 233e5ba5, cardfix44.py af903431, mk_card_1837.py a19e1bd6). A live dry run of readtime.sh on the real poll.log with a mocked SELECTED gave code PENDING, case a, and no push. All evening-chain jobs are alive (poller 37016, watcher 30864, manual_admit 3028, waiter 29828, t7 16748, reader 19012, timers 18:37/19:43/21:05/00:07Z). Three wording defects remain in how CONTEXT 17:54Z tells the session to use the block. (1) msg44.py has the exp87a pairs hard-coded. After a >= 0.960 promotion and a correct re-tick to {exp89t, #37}, pushtext44 prints 'SELECTED is neither...' while readtime says case=a. (2) Re-running pushtext44 at the 19:43Z, 21:05Z and manual-admit checks re-sends the read push. (3) If exp89t is PENDING at the 19:44:45Z [manual-admit] or 19:45:38Z header, the push needs ADMIT_PENDING=1; without it the session sends the contradictory T7 text. Round-44's scan command_blocks had the correct per-event rules, but they were lost when the CONTEXT line was written. Ops: the laptop is on battery at 67% (18:19Z) and drains ~28%/h, so it empties around 20:25-20:40Z (23:25-23:40 MSK). That is after the tick but before the 00:05 MSK check and the 03:07 MSK post-deadline job. The current watchdog (16220) does not alert on battery percent. The R44-A5 stop list names dead PIDs. No change to the finals, decision B or R1-R10.

findings.what: pushtext44 at the 19:43Z / 21:05Z SELECTED checks (and at any event after the first read) gives a wrong or duplicate push. msg44.py hard-codes A={exp87a 56640366, #37 56563521} and B={exp87a, exp75 56656157}, so after a T1/T2 promotion and a CORRECT user re-tick to {exp89t 56669888, #37} or {exp89t, exp75} it prints 'SELECTED is neither {exp87a,#37} nor {exp87a,exp75}: send the card's steps() line / the R39-A4 push'. In the same run readtime.sh prints 'SELECTED case=a' (comparator V_pub=56669888), which is correct. readtime.sh also keys on the FIRST terminal header, so on a T3KEEP/T5 read pushtext44 re-emits the same read push at every later event. CONTEXT 17:54Z (R44-A2) says to run the one block, 'source readtime.sh; HOLD-guard else pushtext44', at EVERY event and to 'send every pushtext44 line except CONTEXT FIRST', so a literal use sends duplicates and, after a promotion, a false 'wrong pair' path.
findings.evidence: Reproduced 18:18Z (0 Kaggle calls): LOG=<SP>/r44dry/poll_T1.log + SELMOCK '56669888, 56563521' -> readtime 'SELECTED case=a (... comparator V_pub=56669888)'; msg44.py CODE=T1 SEL=56669888,56563521 -> 'SELECTED is neither ...'; the same for SEL=56669888,56656157. msg44 CODE=T3KEEP NOWZ=21:05:10Z -> re-sends 'exp89t = 0.959 (21:25 МСК ...) ... ничего менять не нужно'. The per-event rules existed in research/wf_ideas_v4/round44/scan_hyp_ops44.json command_blocks ('19:43Z and 21:05Z SELECTED checks: case a/b -> no push; a_old/b_old -> pushtext44 (re-send the T1/T2 text); other 2-ref set -> steps line only') but are absent from CONTEXT.md and round44/report.json.
findings.action: Append one CONTEXT line now (0 Kaggle calls): 'R45 PER-EVENT RULE for the R44-A2 block: pushtext44 is sent ONLY at the FIRST event that sees exp89t terminal (the read push), at T7 (PENDING, first clean header >= 19:12:17Z), and at the admit edge (R45-PC-02). At every LATER event (manual-admit reader after an earlier read, 19:43Z, 21:05Z) source readtime.sh and act only on its "SELECTED case=" line: a or b -> log only, no push; a_old or b_old (a T1/T2 promotion not yet re-ticked) -> re-send the T1/T2 push line, which is correct because SEL is still the old pair; d -> push the exact untick/tick steps to П3 {V_pub, #37 56563521}, where V_pub = exp89t only after T1/T2; selok=0 twice -> the "Не смог проверить" line only. Never send the msg44 "SELECTED is neither" line to the user; it is an internal line.' Do not edit msg44.py or readtime.sh now (sha8s are logged).

findings.what: If exp89t is still PENDING at the [manual-admit] header 19:44:45Z (or at the first poller header after the edge, ~19:45:38Z, when the manual call failed), readtime.sh codes it PENDING with the header >= 19:12:17Z. msg44 then prints the T7 text 'основным станет, только если по записи поллера прочитается до 22:45 МСК ...' at 22:44-22:45 MSK, which contradicts the edge. The correct 'exp89t не прочитан к 22:45 МСК ... в финал он не идёт при любом паблике' text needs ADMIT_PENDING=1. That flag appears nowhere in CONTEXT.md or round44/report.json, only in the round-44 scan command_blocks.
findings.evidence: Simulated 18:18Z: msg44 CODE=PENDING H=2026-09-29T19:44:45Z (and 19:45:38Z), no flag -> T7 text; with ADMIT_PENDING=1 -> 'exp89t не прочитан к 22:45 МСК (ручная проверка 22:45 МСК, 19:45 UTC — ещё считается): в финал он не идёт при любом паблике; ... ничего менять не нужно.' grep ADMIT_PENDING: only research/wf_ideas_v4/round44/scan_hyp_ops44.json.
findings.action: Same CONTEXT line as R45-PC-01, plus: 'At the manual-admit reader (~19:47Z) or the first clean header after 19:45:17Z, if READ says code=PENDING, run ADMIT_PENDING=1 pushtext44 (send once; for a poller header, replace "ручная проверка" with "поллер" by hand). A later terminal header gets the T8 text (pushtext44, no flag).' A T7 text already sent at ~19:15Z is not re-sent at the edge.

findings.what: The post-deadline stop list is stale. R44-A5 (1) says to stop watchdog v2 30176/16728 FIRST at 00:07Z, but both PIDs are gone. The live watchdog is the battery watchdog 16220 (wrapper 9596). If the laptop is still on battery at 00:07Z and the poller 37016 is stopped first, 16220 prints 'NO CLEAN POLL' ~25 min later (~00:32Z, 03:32 MSK), which is a false alert. If the laptop goes back to AC before then, 16220 exits with 'BACK ON AC' and nothing watches the poller during the 19:15-19:45Z window, unless the watchdog is re-armed as R39-A8 requires.
